description: Add contacts to a campaign: a list of ids, or every contact matching the filters list_contacts takes, minus the ones in `exclude` (at most 50,000). With "all matching", pass `expectedCount`, the number you confirmed: if a different number match now, nothing is added and it answers 409. A contact already in it is counted in `alreadyIn` and left as it was. Contacts who unsubscribed or are on the suppression list can be added, but the campaign never writes to them. On a running campaign the list gate judges the leads after the add: if the known-invalid share would reach 4%, nothing is added and it answers 409 `leadsInvalidShare` with the counts. If the leads can't be counted, nothing is added and it answers a retryable 503 `leadCountsUnavailable`. An API key an owner limited to other campaigns adds no leads here, running or not (403, `details.scope: "keyCampaign"`). On a running campaign, a change that adds to what it sends or to whom also needs the `send` permission, and makes the caller its approver. Through an API key an owner limited, the key's limits must cover the campaign, every mailbox it sends from and outreach, or it answers 403 with `details.scope` naming the limit. A change that only takes something out needs none of that.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

expectedCount.description: How many contacts you expect this to touch: the count you showed or checked (count_contacts, minus the ones in exclude). If the contacts that match changed since, nothing happens and it answers 409 serverErrors.selectionChanged, with the number that match now in params.count.

check.description: Only contacts whose address check is at this point. valid, risky, unknown: a fresh verdict of ours. invalid: the address can't receive mail. not_checked: we never checked it (an imported verdict that isn't invalid counts as not checked). checking: a check is under way. waiting: a check is on hold. needs_retry: no answer came back, so check it again. out_of_date: our verdict is too old.

segmentId.description: Only contacts in this segment (list_segments): whoever matches its conditions now. It combines with the other filters. A segment that was deleted answers 404.
